descriptionFromApi:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.


You Are

You have spent the better part of a decade building CAD infrastructure that has to hold up under real silicon development pressure, not just proof-of-concept demos or similar domains. You know that the difference between a flow that gets adopted and one that gets worked around is usually in the details no one else thought about. Lately, you have been watching the explosion of agentic AI and LLM orchestration, and instead of seeing hype, you see exactly how autonomous agents could transform the way IP gets designed, verified, and managed across its lifecycle.


You are someone who can sit with IP designers who need faster turnaround on design and verification and walk out with a multi-agent workflow spec that actually solves their problem. You do not wait for the AI platform team to tell you what is possible. You prototype, you integrate, you prove the concept, and then you scale it. You have strong opinions about what makes infrastructure scalable, and you are not afraid to push back when a proposed solution will not survive the challenges of a scalable production use.


At Synopsys, you will work at the center of Silicon Lifecycle Management (SLM) IP development in the AI Center of Excellence team, architecting AI Infrastructure, building Agents from scratch, leveraging when possible and customizing to the team needs. The problems are hard, the scale is real, and what you build will reshape how thousands of engineers work.


What You'll Be Doing

  • Architect and define the next generation of AI-powered CAD infrastructure for Silicon IP development, building and integrating autonomous agents into core design and verification workflows
  • Build Agentic frameworks and Agents to improve Engineering productivity of the organization
  • Deploy and operationalize Synopsys' global Agentic AI platform directly into the SLM IP development loop, building orchestration layers that connect LLMs, agents, and EDA toolchains across design, verification, synthesis, PnR, and timing
  • Design multi-agent workflows that automate IP design tasks, verification loops, and lifecycle analytics, turning manual bottlenecks into autonomous, scalable processes
  • Partner with IP design teams, CAD engineers, and global AI platform teams to align architecture with real engineering needs and deployment constraints
  • Build and maintain the infrastructure layer that connects silicon design phases with AI-driven automation, ensuring performance, reliability, and scalability across the full IP lifecycle
  • Prototype, test, and validate new AI-CAD integrations in live development environments, iterating based on feedback from design teams and measurable workflow improvements
  • Drive technical strategy and roadmap for AI-augmented CAD systems within SLM, translating emerging AI capabilities into concrete engineering solutions
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the team, fostering best practices

The Impact You Will Have

  • Enable IP design and verification teams to move faster by automating repetitive, high-friction tasks through intelligent agent-driven workflows
  • Reduce time-to-market for SLM IP by building scalable CAD infrastructure that adapts to design complexity without linear increases in manual effort
  • Set the technical foundation for how Synopsys integrates agentic AI into silicon development, influencing architecture decisions across the broader EDA organization
  • Improve design quality and lifecycle visibility by embedding AI-driven analytics and telemetry into the core IP development flow
  • Accelerate adoption of Synopsys' Agentic AI platform by proving its value in one of the most demanding, high-stakes engineering environments in the company
  • Shape the future of CAD infrastructure at Synopsys, defining patterns and practices that will scale across multiple IP families and product lines
  • Directly influence how thousands of engineers experience their daily workflows, making complex silicon development more efficient, predictable, and autonomous

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, VLSI, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
  • 12+ years of hands-on experience developing and deploying advanced CAD flows and infrastructure in silicon design environments
  • Proven experience implementing Agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent platforms, LLM orchestrations, or autonomous software agent systems in production settings
  • Mastery of Python and C++ for building production-grade infrastructure, plus strong proficiency in EDA scripting languages like Tcl, Perl, and Shell
  • Track record of building agents and orchestration layers that interact with design, verification, synthesis, PnR, and timing flows
  • Technical understanding of silicon design phases, particularly IP development, verification, and lifecycle management workflows, is a plus
  • Experience with Silicon Lifecycle Management concepts such as in-chip sensing, telemetry, and analytics is a strong plus

Who You Are

  • You can walk into a room full of IP designers talking about verification bottlenecks and walk out with a clear architecture for an agent-driven solution that actually fits their workflow
  • You prototype fast and iterate based on real feedback, not theoretical requirements, and you know the difference between a demo that impresses and a system that ships
  • You have a point of view on what makes CAD infrastructure scalable and maintainable, and you are comfortable defending that view with technical depth and real-world examples
  • You are comfortable operating in ambiguity, especially when integrating cutting-edge AI technologies into established silicon development environments where stability and correctness are non-negotiable
  • You think in systems, understanding how changes in one part of the CAD flow ripple through design, verification, and downstream lifecycle analytics
  • You do not need perfect documentation or fully baked requirements to get started, you ask the right questions, align stakeholders, and find a path forward

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will be part of the Silicon Lifecycle Management IP Development team in Bangalore, working at the intersection of advanced IP design and AI-driven automation. This team is responsible for building the infrastructure and workflows that power SLM IP development across Synopsys, and you will be the principal engineer defining how agentic AI gets integrated into that foundation. You will collaborate closely with IP designers, CAD engineers, and Synopsys' global Agentic AI platform teams, bridging technical domains and driving alignment across a distributed, highly technical organization. This is a Principal Individual Contributor role with significant technical leadership responsibilities across multiple globally distributed engineering teams. This role may evolve into leading a small team of AI infrastructure engineers as adoption scales.


Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.


At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

Framework work should emerge from what the pod proves in production: tooling choices, review practices, guardrails, and team habits that other squads can pick up without reinventing the wheel.

Tech stack

Lead Architect - Full-Stack, Cloud, Data & AI Engineering

Technical leadership of the end-to-end build, with accountability for establishing the teams deployment capability and mentoring Forward Deployed Engineers to independence

Full-stack engineering

Mode of working - Guide, review, spike

Azure cloud architecture

Mode of working - Own and decide

Data engineering

What the role is accountable for - PySpark and Databricks pipeline architecture, layered data design, quality controls and performance standards

Mode of working - Direct and review

AI engineering & AIOps

What the role is accountable for - Agent and orchestration design, evaluation harnesses, guardrails, human-approval flows, tracing, versioning and drift monitoring

Mode of working - Own and direct

Leadership Responsibilities
  • Technical direction: Own the target architecture and the agentic-versus-deterministic decisions; hold the line on where agents add value and where rules or workflows suffice.
  • Lead through the team: Break scope into buildable increments, run design walkthroughs and code reviews, and set the coding, testing, release and documentation standards the team works to.
  • Build deployment capability: Convert todays person-dependent deployment into documented, reusable practice - reference architecture, IaC modules, pipeline templates, runbooks and environment checklists.
  • Mentor FDEs to independence: Pair on builds, review their designs, run structured enablement, and hand over deployment ownership against defined competency milestones.
  • Stakeholder ownership: Carry architecture and security posture through client technology and security review; act as final technical escalation on deployment and production issues.
  • Selective hands-on: Prototype high-risk components, resolve critical-path blockers, and review production code - sufficient depth to make credible decisions, without becoming the delivery bottleneck.
Required Experience
  • 10+ years in software, platform or applied AI engineering, including 4+ years leading engineering teams on systems that reached production.
  • Full-stack delivery background - Python, relational and NoSQL stores, web application deployment, CI/CD and DevOps practice.
  • Hands-on architecture experience with the standing to own and defend decisions with client cloud and security teams.
  • Working depth in PySpark and Databricks, and in agent development with a mainstream orchestration framework plus evaluation and production monitoring.
  • Demonstrated record of mentoring engineers and raising team capability - not only shipping personally.
Success Measures
  • Named FDEs deploy and operate solutions independently; delivery is not dependent on this individual.
  • Time-to-deploy reduces engagement over engagement through reusable assets and standards.
  • Solutions reach production on committed timelines, with architecture and security accepted with minimal remediation.
  • Agent quality, availability, latency and cloud cost tracked against defined baselines, with regressions caught pre-release.

Job Summary
Nexla is the leading Integration platform, built with AI, for AI. Nexla takes a metadata driven approach to converge diverse integrations across Data, Documents, Agents, Applications, and APIs into a single design pattern. We accelerate the development of solutions for GenAI, Analytics, and Inter-company data. Nexla makes data users and developers up to 10x more productive by delivering a true blend of no-code, low-code, and pro-code interfaces.
Leading companies including DoorDash, LinkedIn, Johnson & Johnson, and LiveRamp trust Nexla for mission-critical data. Named in the 2022, 2023, and 2024 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Data Integration Tools and top-rated by customers on Gartner Peer Insights, headquartered in San Mateo, California.
At Nexla, our culture is built around our core values: Have Empathy , Be Curious , Be Intellectually Honest , Achieve Excellence , and Remember to Relax . We put our customers at the heart of everything we do, foster a data-driven mindset, take ownership of our work, and believe in the power of teamwork to achieve ambitious goals.
Nexla, briefly
Nexla is the data layer for enterprise AI. We give AI apps and agents the connectivity, context, and governance to work across more than 1,000 enterprise systems in real time, and we process over a trillion records a month doing it. DoorDash, LinkedIn, Johnson & Johnson, Instacart, and LiveRamp run mission-critical data on us. Honorable Mention in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Data Integration Tools, and top-rated by customers on Gartner Peer Insights four years running. Founded 2016, remote-first, headquartered in San Mateo.
Our values are short and we actually use them: Have Empathy. Be Curious. Be Intellectually Honest. Achieve Excellence. Remember to Relax.
Role, briefly
Nexla s connector layer is what talks to everything else: over a thousand SaaS applications, databases, streams, files, and APIs, bidirectionally, each with its own schema quirks, auth scheme, rate limits, and retry semantics. You would be the most senior engineer on it, and the person four to six engineers report to, working alongside our backend, API, and UI teams. The split is roughly 80% hands-on design and code, 20% growing the team. If you are looking to step off the keyboard, this is the wrong job.
What you ll own
  • The architecture of the connector layer. You make the calls on how we abstract a thousand systems and handle formats like JSON, Parquet, and Avro at high throughput, and you write the hard parts yourself.
  • The connector roadmap. You decide what ships, what gets deprecated, and in what order, working directly with product, customer success, and support on what customers actually need.
  • Reliability of what your team ships, on-call included. Fewer failures reaching customers, and better tooling so the team sees problems before customers do.
  • The four to six engineers around you. Hiring, growth, and raising the technical bar, mostly through design review and pairing. Formal management runs to about a day a week.
Ninety days in: you have shipped something non-trivial to production, named the two worst parts of the current design with a proposal attached, and the team has started routing hard design questions to you before they route them upward.
A real problem you d hit here
We have thousands of connectors, with thousands of customer pipelines running on them. Each one has to scale in two directions at once: the volume of data moving through it, and its reliability under that volume. This is not a problem you solve and close. The connector surface keeps growing, so holding both properties is a constantly evolving task, and it is the standing problem of this team.
Must-haves
  • 10+ years building backend systems, and you are still hands-on. You can point at code you wrote recently and are proud of.
  • Deep JVM experience. You have debugged distributed systems where the failure was not in the code you wrote.
  • Production depth in Kafka, Redis or Memcached, and APIs over gRPC and REST, Kubernetes at high throughput.
  • You have led engineers technically: design review, mentoring, raising the bar on a team. Formal people-management experience is welcome but not required.
  • You use AI tools in your actual work and can say specifically where they help and where they mislead you.
Bonus points
  • Data integration, ETL, or iPaaS background.
  • You have wrangled JSON, Parquet, Avro, and worse at scale.
  • You have carried direct reports before, including performance conversations.
You ll thrive here if
  • Urgency is your default. Youd rather ship a good answer this week than a perfect one next quarter, and you make that call without being asked.
  • You own the outcome, not your slice of it. When something breaks between two teams, you fix it rather than route it.
  • You close loops. What you pick up gets finished, and the people around you stop having to follow up.
  • You set the pace. Four to six engineers will calibrate their urgency to yours, and you know that.
  • You want the design authority that comes with the title without giving up the keyboard.
One thing to be clear about: this role grows through technical depth and scope, not through headcount. The 80/20 split is deliberate and will stay that way
How we hire
  • Exploratory call with our CTO. A real conversation about the problem space and whether this scope is what you actually want. 45 min.
  • Design and architecture. How you shape systems, on problems close to what we run in production. 60 min.
  • Distributed systems design. Throughput, failure modes, and the tradeoffs you would defend under pressure. 60 min.
  • Coding. Working through real code rather than a puzzle. 60 min.
  • Leadership conversation with a co-founder. Ownership, judgment, and how you raise the bar of the people around you. 45 min.
On AI in the coding round.
Use it the way you would on the job, ours or anyone else s. We build AI tooling and we expect you to use AI tooling, so watching you work without it would tell us nothing useful. What we dig into is your judgment: what you delegated, what you verified, and what you threw away.
You will hear from us either way.
The practical stuff
Worth a look before you apply:
  • What we are building now. MCP Studio and Express , our two newest bets.
  • Who uses us, and why.
  • The product in engineer terms.
  • Our CEO on why we take "Remember to Relax"

Position Summary

The Solutions Architecture Manager is a highly proficient, hands-on solution architect for RSM custom solutions. This role owns end-to-end microservice and API architecture for assigned solutions, defines Domain-Driven Design boundaries and event-driven patterns on Azure Service Bus, and sets engineering standards across React frontend and .NET/Python backend teams. The role operates with growing autonomy across the custom solutions estate and represents designs in architecture reviews.


Key Responsibilities

  • Translate business and product requirements into end-to-end solution designs for RSM custom solutions spanning multiple frontend and backend services.
  • Adapt quickly to evolving engineering priorities, market trends, and emerging technologies; rapidly evaluate new technology areas and produce proof-of-concepts, technical assessments, and analysis reports to support timely decision-making and delivery expectations.
  • Design microservice and API architectures for custom-built solutions; define service boundaries using Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles.
  • Architect event-driven integration patterns using Azure Service Bus; define message schemas, topic/subscription models, and error-handling strategies.
  • Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and engineering best practices across frontend (React) and backend (.NET / Python) teams.
  • Ensure non-functional requirements (security, scalability, resiliency, observability) are embedded into all solution designs.
  • Lead architecture and design reviews for new features, technical initiatives, and third-party integrations within assigned solutions.
  • Produce and maintain architecture decision records (ADRs), high-level design (HLD) documents, and API specifications (OpenAPI/Swagger).
  • Collaborating with product managers, UX designers, and engineering leads to shape technical roadmaps.
  • Provide technical mentorship to senior engineers and conduct design and code reviews.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 10+ years of software engineering or architecture experience, with at least 5 years in a solution architect role on complex, multi-service platforms.
  • Expert-level proficiency in designing microservices architectures and RESTful / GraphQL APIs.
  • Deep hands-on experience with React (frontend architecture) and .NET and/or Python (backend services).
  • Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL database platforms, including data modeling, partitioning, indexing, performance optimization, and selection of appropriate persistence patterns for distributed, cloud-native applications.
  • Working knowledge of observability and operational excellence, including monitoring strategies, distributed tracing, telemetry standards, and production diagnostics using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry.
  • Strong experience with Azure cloud services, including Azure Service Bus, Azure API Management, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and Azure DevOps.
  • Advanced understanding of Domain-Driven Design, CQRS, Event Sourcing, and distributed systems patterns.
  • Hands-on knowledge and experience in designing and implementing AI-enabled solutions using AI agent frameworks, Azure AI services such as Azure AI Foundry and Azure AI Search, and LLMs/SLMs.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes), and DevSecOps practices.
  • Working knowledge of OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 and fine-grained authorization in multi-tenant SaaS environments.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, including API-led connectivity, event-driven messaging, asynchronous communication patterns, data synchronization, system interoperability, and integration platform technologies used to connect cloud, SaaS, and custom applications.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; experience presenting designs to senior technology stakeholders.
  • Professional services or B2B SaaS product experience is advantageous.
  • Experience with BPM and integration platforms (e.g., Camunda, Boomi, MuleSoft) is highly desirable.
  • Experience architecting Agentic AI solutions is preferred.


Core Skills & Technologies

  • Microservices Architecture
  • API Design
  • Azure Service Bus
  • React
  • .NET
  • Python
  • Domain-Driven Design
  • Event-Driven Architecture
  • Azure Cloud
  • CI/CD & DevSecOps
  • NFRs
  • Architecture Review

Must have skills : Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service

Good to have skills : NA
Minimum 12 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:
As an Application Lead, you will be responsible for leading the effort to design, build, and configure applications using Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service. Your typical day will involve collaborating with cross-functional teams, managing project timelines, and ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality applications.

Roles & Responsibilities:
A. Lead the design, development, and deployment of applications using Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search-Cognitive Search, Azure Language Services-CLU, Microsoft Bot Framework,Microsoft Power Virtual Agents-Microsoft Copilot Studio and Azure PaaS.
B. Act as the primary point of contact for the project, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure project timelines are met.
C. Ensure the successful delivery of high-quality applications, adhering to best practices and industry standards.
D. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and growth.
E. Stay updated with the latest advancements in Azure components, Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search-Cognitive Search and Azure Language Services-CLU integrating innovative approaches for sustained competitive advantage.

Professional & Technical Skills:
A. Must Have Skills: Strong architectural experience with Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search-Cognitive Search, Azure Language Services-CLU and Azure PaaS.
B. Must Have Skills: At least 1+ year hands on experience in Azure based LLMs with knowledge in embeddings, vectorization and semantic, vector based indexing and search.
C. Must to Have Skills: Experience with conversational AI with Microsoft Bot Framework or Power Virtual Agents,Microsoft Copilot Studio. Should know how multiple components integrate with each other in an enterprise application.
D. Must Have Skills: Strong understanding of software development best practices including Agile methodologies and industry standards with special focus on API, function app and logic app building. Experience with Python or C hash programming language, using Visual Studio Code IDE and Azure AI Studio.
E. Good To Have Skills: Knowledge of other vector databases, Knowledge Graphs, LangChain, Semantic Kernel.
F. Good To Have Skills: Experience with deployment of applications and containerization technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes.
G. Good To Have Skills: Experience with all Azure AI services like Video Indexer, Computer Vision, Custom Vision, Document Intelligence, Custom QnA, Speech Services and Prompt Engineering.
H. Experience with database technologies such as SQL Server, Cosmos DB and Oracle.
I. Solid grasp of software testing and quality assurance principles.
J. Knowledge of DevOps practices.
  • The candidate should have a minimum of 12 years of experience in software development.
  • The ideal candidate will possess a strong educational background in computer science or a related field, along with a proven track record of delivering impactful solutions.
  • This position is based at our Bengaluru office.

    Qualification 15 years full time education

title: S&C GN - TS&T - Technology Transformation Delivery - Senior Manager
jobDescription:
Transformation Delivery Lead Senior Manager

Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to drive large-scale technology transformation programs for our most strategic clients. You will lead the end-to-end transformation execution, ensuring programs deliver committed business outcomes, financial targets, operational improvements, and stakeholder expectations across Technology Modernization, AI Enterprise Transformation, M&A and Enterprise Agility pillars

Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: Transformation Delivery
Level: Senior Manager

Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad

Years of Exp: 12 - 17 years

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture

Do you thrive on leading complex transformations, improving SDLC using AI, Mainframe Modernization, Data & AI, building domain driven Architecture and high-stakes transformation programs Are you a delivery leader who is passionate about complex Technology Delivery and helping portfolio level leads, directors and business executives drive technology change that delivers real commercial outcomes Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture

If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and lead and deliver complex, high-value transformation portfolios for global clients. Working at C-suite level, you will take Revenue (P&L) accountability for accounts and portfolios, managing budgets from $5M to $30M, scaling delivery organizations, and ensuring transformation investments generates lasting revenue and business value. You will govern multi-programme portfolios, drive commercial growth, and serve as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation at the highest levels of client organizations.

The Practice A Brief Sketch

Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Digital Core Reinvention Partner and focuses on our clients most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through technology transformation initiatives, aimed at modernizing delivery, improving operational performance and generating measurable enterprise value.

We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, large-scale programme delivery and business transformation, where you will work with key global clients to drive the next evolution of enterprise technology change. As part of this high-performing team, you will lead organizations through complex transformation journeys from for translating transformation vision into measurable business outcomes through disciplined execution across global teams, functions, and delivery partners. This is a delivery leadership role with direct accountability for transformation outcomes These are some of the initiatives you will support:

Enterprise Transformation Portfolio Leadership: Own and lead a portfolio of strategic transformation initiatives aligned to portfolio priorities and growth objectives, ensure transformation programs deliver measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, customer impact, and financial value. End-to-End Delivery Accountability: Assume full accountability for transformation execution from mobilization through implementation, stabilization, and value realization including complex systems implementation, Mainframe Modernization, and cloud-native migration programs, lead multiple concurrent, large-scale transformation programs with significant organizational, operational, and technology complexity. AI & Intelligent Transformation Leadership: Lead and manage scaled deployment of Agentic AI, Generative AI, automation, and digital workforce solutions as part of enterprise transformation programs, establish governance, risk management, and adoption frameworks for responsible deployment of AI-enabled transformation initiatives. Revenue Management and Financial Governance: Manage actuals, forecasts, margin protection, revenue recognition and commercial change control; identify and drive revenue growth opportunities and account expansions.

Integration and Dependency Management: Govern complex multi-programme integration across internal teams, client stakeholders and third-party vendors; manage interdependencies, interface points, data migration streams and system integration programmes to ensure coherent, risk-managed portfolio delivery; lead cloud-native and API-led architecture transitions within delivery programmes. Value Realization and Benefits Framework: Track measurable transformation outcomes across the portfolio cost reduction, revenue growth, operational efficiency, risk reduction and speed-to-market; report on value delivered at portfolio level Global Delivery Leadership: Act as a trusted partner to senior business leaders, lead executive governance forums and transformation steering committees, communicate complex delivery and business challenges clearly, providing actionable recommendations and mitigation strategies. Executive Stakeholder Leadership: Shape Portfolio level narratives, transformation roadmaps and investment choices at portfolio level; advise on vendor strategy and scale-up plans; lead deal-shaping and account growth, representing Accenture externally and contributing to practice development and market offerings

Role Summary

As Delivery Lead Senior Manager, you will own end-to-end delivery of one or more large, complex transformation programmes with budgets typically ranging from $5M to $30M. You will lead high-impact delivery for programs on a scale, and align outcomes to strategic client objectives. You will engage at Portfolio level, drive revenue management and commercial growth, embed continuous improvement, and make decisions that carry major, lasting impact across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end programme delivery, ensuring outcomes are on time, on budget, and aligned to contractual SLAs and KPIs.
  • Define and enforce portfolio-level delivery standards, governance frameworks, and quality controls; lead the introduction and embedment of Agile delivery models, CI/CD practices and modern ways of working within client organizations.
  • Lead portfolio-level governance forums and Steering Committees; act as executive delivery sponsor with the client.
  • Manage relationships at Portfolio and director level; act as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation.
  • Manage risk, escalation decisions, and demand/supply balance across the portfolio.
  • Lead identification and scaling of continuous improvement and delivery innovation initiatives across the portfolio.
  • Drive Agentic AI-powered transformation; articulate and demonstrate prior experience using Agentic AI in transformation contexts to clients and internal stakeholders, building confidence and adoption.
  • Manage and facilitate the governance of large programs comprising 50-150+ FTEs including mentoring and coaching people in the programs
  • Represent Accenture externally; contribute to practice development, capability strategy, and market offerings.
  • Lead deal-shaping and proposal strategy for significant account expansions and new pursuits.
  • Shape and negotiate commercial terms; manage material changes to contract scope and commercial structure.

What We''re Looking For

  • 12 17 years total experience; 4 6 years in senior programme delivery within a large professional services or consulting firm, including hands-on management of budgets in the $5M $30M range.
  • Proven ability to govern complex, multi-programme transformation portfolios in a large global services environment, with direct accountability for delivery, revenue and commercial outcomes.
  • Demonstrated track record of Portfolio-level stakeholder engagement, influence, and relationship management.

  • Experience leading organisational change and embedding operational performance improvements at scale.
  • Track record of account growth, deal-shaping, and business development alongside delivery execution.
  • Strong executive presence: communicates with clarity and gravitas; builds trust with senior audiences rapidly.
  • Must have experience of working across at least one of the following areas; Technology Modernisation, Complex Delivery, Drive Transformation, Revenue Management.

Set yourself apart:

  • Mastery of managing complex deliveries coordinating with more than one supplier with multiple dependencies and work plans
  • Experience delivering cloud-native transformation programs leveraging Cloud Technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), microservices architectures, API-led integration, or SaaS platforms
  • Experience of delivering transformation at scale within a highly regulated or complex industry sector
  • Cloud/Industry and Programme Management certifications and credentials
  • Demonstrate a strong Technical and Emotional Quotient


What s in it for you

  • An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
  • Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
  • Ability to embed responsible business into everything from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
  • Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities.
  • Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions underpinned by the world s largest delivery network Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 569,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at www.accenture.com

About Digital Core Reinvention Partner:

Digital Core Reinvention Partner helps clients reinvent their digital foundations including technology strategy and architecture, AI and data, modernizing and managing applications, infrastructure, and cloud. We operate in lockstep with our Reinvention Engines especially Technology and AI and Data. In practice, Digital Core brings the integrated client solution and team together, while the Engines continuously strengthen the skills, tools, methods, and AI-enabled delivery that those teams use. And Client Success will ensure our solutions are commercially strong, repeatable, and aligned to what clients truly need bringing the full strength of Accenture to every engagement. To bring this global perspective to our clients, Digital Core Reinvention Partner s services include those provided by our Global Network a distributed organization that provides advisory and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Our Global Network teams complement our in-country teams to deliver cutting-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world.

For more information visit Welcome to Digital Core | Digital Core

At the heart of every great change is a great human. If you have ideas, ingenuity and a passion for making a difference, come and be a part of our team




Qualification

Qualifications & Certifications

  • Bachelor''s degree (relevant discipline); Master''s / MBA strongly preferred.
  • PMP, MSP, or equivalent programme management certification.
  • SAFe, or equivalent Agile certification.

Cloud/enterprise platform certifications (AWS, Azure, Guidewire, SAP, ServiceNow etc.) advantageous

title: Custom Software Engineer
jobDescription:
Project Role : Custom Software Engineer

Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.

Must have skills : SAP ABAP Cloud

Good to have skills : NA
Minimum 15 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary
AI Powered Tech Talent. Build AI native, cloud ready SAP solutions on ABAP Cloud by combining deep ABAP and SAP platform expertise with agentic AI architectures, LLM tooling, and rapid experimentation. The role focuses on designing, implementing, and scaling intelligent SAP applications that integrate ABAP Cloud with LLMs, retrieval pipelines, APIs, and enterprise systemsmoving from automation to autonomy.
This role actively builds AI systems, not just consumes AI tools.

Core Responsibilities
AI Native SAP Application Build
Design and build ABAP Cloud applications that embed LLM driven intelligence into SAP business processes.
Implement AI enabled SAP extensions using RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), event driven patterns, and cloud native architectures.
Develop clean, testable ABAP code that integrates seamlessly with AI services and enterprise APIs.
Agentic LLM Integration
Implement agentic workflows: tools, planners, memory, orchestration, and evaluation loops integrated with SAP processes.
Integrate LLMs, embeddings, and retrieval pipelines (RAG) with ABAP Cloud services for contextual, grounded responses.
Design prompt templates, grounding strategies, fallback logic, and safety boundaries suitable for enterprise SAP use cases.
Data, Retrieval Context
Build and integrate retrieval pipelines using SAP and non SAP data sources (business objects, CDS views, documents, events).
Implement chunking, indexing, embeddings, and context assembly to support production grade RAG scenarios.
Ensure factuality, traceability, and explainability in AI driven SAP workflows.
Quality, Safety Reliability
Implement evaluation frameworks (offline and online) for AI behaviors integrated with SAP processes.
Design guardrails for authorization, data privacy, action boundaries, and error handling.
Build observability into AI enabled SAP applications (telemetry, logging, failure analysis).
Rapid Experimentation Scale Out
Prototype quickly, demo frequently, and iterate based on business feedback.
Move AI prototypes into enterprise grade SAP production systems with performance, security, and compliance in mind.
Continuously refine AI behavior, prompts, and orchestration strategies.

Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)
SAP ABAP Cloud (RAP, CDS, OData, clean core principles).
Hands on experience integrating LLMs and AI services into applications.
Experience building RAG pipelines, embeddings, and contextual retrieval.
Strong software engineering fundamentals (design, testing, CI/CD).
Ability to translate business problems into AI enabled SAP solutions.

Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
Experience with SAP BTP, eventing, APIs, and cloud services.
Familiarity with agent frameworks or custom orchestration logic.
Exposure to vector databases, search, or semantic indexing (SAP native or external).
Knowledge of enterprise security, authorization, and compliance patterns.


Value Delivered
Intelligent SAP applications that reason, retrieve, and act, not just automate.
Faster innovation cycles by embedding AI directly into SAP business logic.
Scalable, secure AI powered SAP extensions aligned with clean core principles.
Foundation for autonomous, AI driven enterprise workflows.

Additional Information
A 15 years full time education is required.


Qualification 15 years full time education
